executiveSummary.headline: Protect Category Leadership by Correcting Stale and Conflicting Official Facts
executiveSummary.lead: JW Marriott Hotel Santo Domingo holds the strongest certified peer position in its four-hotel set and appears in 47 of 48 eligible scenarios. The immediate opportunity is fact control: remove or date a 2024 pool-maintenance alert, reconcile event-room terminology, and make verified dining, BlueMall/Piantini, and access facts consistently usable.
executiveSummary.metricsNote: AI Consideration is the share of 192 comparable monitored answers mentioning the hotel; Scenario Presence is the share of 48 eligible traveler-need scenarios where it appeared. Certified Peer Position uses the four-hotel Marriott Bonvoy set. These measures do not represent bookings, ADR, revenue, or traveler exposure.

themes.title: A Stale Pool Notice Creates Current-State Ambiguity
themes.what: The official overview still says the pool will remain closed from January 21, 2024 while the same page markets a complimentary outdoor infinity pool.
themes.whyItMatters: Guests and automated systems need a dated, current operating status.

themes.title: Event Inventory Uses Competing Labels
themes.what: The overview markets nine venues while the events page reports five event rooms and seven breakout rooms.
themes.whyItMatters: A setup-qualified inventory avoids planner confusion without treating divisible spaces as errors.

themes.title: Dining Exists but Is Absent From the ADP Attribute Read
themes.what: Winston's, Vertygo 101, and 24-hour in-room dining are official, while restaurant and in-room dining recognition were 0%.
themes.whyItMatters: This is a content-priority signal, not proof that content caused measured performance.

recommendedSteps: Open a Marriott CDN/WAF review with the exact user agent and redirect chain.
Make only narrow approved changes if a conflict is verified.

methodology.scope: Combines the pinned certified ADP baseline with a bounded review of named public pages and zero-cost technical probes. No paid research, ADP remeasurement, production write, or customer publication was performed.
claimTypeGuide: VERIFIED_ISSUE — a directly observed, source-backed discrepancy.
RECOMMENDED_INVESTIGATION — evidence warrants review but does not prove a defect or cause.
REQUIRES_HOTEL_CONFIRMATION — leadership must establish the source of truth before correction.
OPTIONAL_COMMERCIAL_OPPORTUNITY — proceed only if leadership wants the demand.
responsibilities: Hotel leadership confirms facts, priorities, and public changes.
Digital, brand, and partner teams implement only approved corrections and document verification.
Dealality packages measurement context and evidence without implying ranking, booking, ADR, or revenue causation.
methodology.monthlyReviewRelationship: Approved actions may be tracked later. Completing an action does not itself prove a change in AI presence, bookings, ADR, or revenue.
methodology.nextStep: Approve the highest-priority source-of-truth decision, then authorize only the validated work.
